metadata.question: During the year of 2018, did Washington D.C. experience at least 50 inches of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Location: Washington D.C. (point or small polygon) - Date: Year 2018 (2018-01-01 to 2018-12-31) - Dataset: NOAA/PERSIANN-CDR for precipitation data or CHIRPS for rainfall estimates - PERSIANN-CDR is daily rainfall data, suitable for accumulation over a year - 50 inches ≈ 1270 mm 2. **Masking strategy**: - No cloud masking needed; precipitation data is already processed - Need to accumulate daily rainfall for the entire year 2018 3. **Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error**: - If no images in the collection: C1 - If pixel count is 0 after filtering: C2 - If the result is NaN/None or physically impossible: C3 - If total rainfall >= 50 inches: A (Yes) - If total rainfall < 50 inches: B (No) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Washington D.C. location const dcPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([-77.0369, 38.9072]); const dcBuffer = dcPoint.buffer(10000); // ~10 km buffer for region // Define 2018 date range const startDate = '2018-01-01'; const endDate = '2018-12-31'; // Load PERSIANN-CDR daily rainfall data let rainCollection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/PERSIANN-CDR') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(dcBuffer); // Check if collection has data const colSize = await rainCollection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2018 Daily Rainfall Images: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log('No rainfall data found for 2018 in Washington D.C.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Sum all daily precipitation over the year const totalRainfall = rainCollection .select('precipitation') .sum(); // Calculate total rainfall in mm const stats = await totalRainfall.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.first(), geometry: dcPoint, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const totalMm = stats['precipitation']; const totalInches = totalMm / 25.4; // Validate result if (totalMm === null || totalMm === undefined || isNaN(totalMm)) { console.log('Rainfall calculation returned null or NaN.'); console.log('C3'); return; } if (totalMm <= 0) { console.log('Total rainfall is 0 or negative - likely no valid pixels.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Output results console.log(`2018 Total Rainfall: ${totalInches.toFixed(2)} inches (${totalMm.toFixed(1)} mm)`); console.log(`Threshold: 50 inches`); // Final answer if (totalInches >= 50) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
